description: WhatsApp is reportedly developing notification bubbles for Android that could let users access chats as floating icons while using other apps. The feature is expected to allow quick replies through a compact chat window without opening the full app. It is still under development and not available in any beta version yet. The feature will likely depend on Android’s notification system and may work best on newer Android versions, with no confirmation of availability on iOS devices.
title: WhatsApp Is Finally Working on Adding Support for Android's Notification Bubbles Feature

description: New observations of Uranus reveal its outer rings contain ice and organic material, suggesting hidden moonlets. The findings offer new clues about the planet’s ring system and the formation of its mysterious satellites.
title: Uranus’ Outer Rings May Reveal Hidden Moons, Scientists Say

description: The OnePlus Pad 4 feels like a more confident step forward for the brand’s tablet lineup. Its slim design, understated Dune Glow finish, and large display give it a strong initial presence, while the core hardware and new Stylo Pro are indicative of a growing focus on productivity. However, how these elements come together in everyday use is something we’ll uncover in our full review of the OnePlus Pad 4.
title: OnePlus Pad 4 First Impressions

description: Infinix GT 50 Pro launched in global markets with dual rear cameras and a 6.78-inch AMOLED LTPS panel. The new smartphone is equipped with shoulder triggers, and it has a 4nm MediaTek Dimensity 8400 Ultimate chipset under the hood. It carries a  6,500mAh battery with up to 45W wired fast charging support. It boasts an N1 network management chip for enhanced connectivity. The new handset uses Infinix's HydroFlow Liquid Cooling Architecture.
title: Infinix GT 50 Pro Launched With Dimensity 8400 Ultimate, HydroFlow Liquid Cooling, Shoulder Triggers: Price, Features

description: Reliance Jio has launched the Youth and Gaming Plan priced at Rs. 459 in India. The plan offers 61GB total data with 2GB per day plus 5GB extra, along with unlimited calls and SMS for 28 days. It includes benefits like JioGames, FanCode, Snapchat+, JioHotstar access, and 50GB JioAICloud storage. Users also get an 18-month Google Gemini Pro subscription with 5000GB cloud storage, with continued benefits requiring active recharges.
title: Jio Youth and Gaming Plan With Snapchat+, FanCode and Gemini Pro Launched: Price, Benefits

description: Realme C100x will be launched in India soon, a tipster claims. The leaker has also shared an image of the smartphone’s retail box, revealing its design. The phone appears with a pill-shaped rear camera module, housing an LED flash and a dual camera system. The handset is expected to also support NFC for connectivity, the leaked image of the retail box suggests. The rumoured Realme C100x will reportedly be equipped with an 8,000mAh battery. It is expected to feature 45W wired fast charging support. The phone could be offered in two colour options, dubbed Deepblue Tide and Golden Coast.
title: Realme C100x Tipped to Launch in India Soon as Key Specifications and Design Surface Online

description: Morgan Stanley has introduced a Stablecoin Reserves Portfolio, enabling issuers to invest reserves in money market funds. The move aligns with evolving US regulations under the GENIUS Act and reflects growing institutional interest in integrating stablecoins into traditional financial systems.
title: Morgan Stanley Announces MSILF Stablecoin Reserves Portfolio for Issuers

description: Instagram is said to be testing a new image-sharing app called Instants. The Meta-owned social media confirmed to a publication that the standalone app is currently being offered in select markets, including Italy and Spain. Built on a similar premise as Snapchat, Instants would allow users to send and receive disappearing photos and videos. It is said to focus on facilitating the sharing of ephemeral, unedited photos with friends.
title: Instagram Launches Instants App With Disappearing Photos to Rival Snapchat, BeReal

description: The Vivo X500 family is expected to be unveiled later this year, but the screen sizes of the smartphones have now leaked on the Internet. The lineup is said to include a model with a 6.37-inch LTPO flat screen with 1.5K resolution. It is also tipped to feature a handset with a 6.83-inch screen and a third model with a 6.59-inch screen. The lineup could include vanilla Vivo X500, Vivo X500 Pro, and Vivo X500 Pro Max models. They are likely to run on MediaTek Dimensity chipsets.
title: Vivo X500 Series Tipped to Launch With 144Hz Displays, Ultrasonic Fingerprint Scanners

description: Adobe shared several previews of how its artificial intelligence (AI) and agentic features can help transform marketing workflows. These previews were showcased at the Adobe Summit 2026 during the Sneaks sessions, where the company presents early-stage projects that are currently in the research and development (R&D) stage. These are built by the software giant’s scientists, engineers, product managers, and designers.
title: Adobe Previews New Agentic AI Workflows for Marketing Tasks at Adobe Summit 2026

description: Major changes are afoot at Xbox. Microsoft Gaming CEO Asha Sharma announced at a townhall meeting on Thursday that the company was letting go of the Microsoft Gaming branding and switching to Xbox. Sharma also said Xbox would reevaluate its approach to exclusive games.
title: Microsoft Gaming Rebrands to Xbox, Debuts New Logo as Xbox Chief Says Company Reevaluating Exclusive Games

description: OnePlus Ace 6 Ultra will be equipped with an 8,600mAh battery, the tech firm confirmed on Friday. Moreover, the smartphone is confirmed to support 120W wired fast charging. The company will also equip the handset with an Oppo-branded “Glacier Battery Energy Concentration” (translated from Chinese) chip, which will help the handset offer longer battery life. The company recently revealed that the OnePlus Ace 6 Ultra will sport a 1.5K (1,272 x 2,772 pixels) BOE display, offering up to 165Hz of refresh rate.
title: OnePlus Ace 6 Ultra Battery Capacity Revealed as Company Teases ‘Energy Concentration’ Chip

description: Microsoft made Copilot's agentic capabilities generally available in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint on Wednesday. The new features are being expanded to the different paid tiers of Microsoft 365, and the agentic features will be set as the default. The Redmond-based tech giant said these features will allow Copilot to not only answer queries, but also take action directly on the document.
title: Microsoft Makes Copilot’s Agentic Features in Word, Excel and PowerPoint Generally Available

description: Several DeFi protocols have joined forces to restore rsETH backing after a $293 million exploit at Kelp DAO. The initiative, dubbed “DeFi United,” has already secured significant Ether commitments as platforms work together to address liquidity and bad debt issues in the ecosystem.
title: Kelp Exploit Aftermath: DeFi Protocols Join Hands to Restore rsETH Following $293 Million Hack

description: A fallen leader’s scandal forces his son into politics, igniting a battle to restore legacy and power.
title: Prathichaya (2026) Now Streaming Online: What You Need to Know

description: Xiaomi is reportedly returning to the book-style foldable market this year with the Xiaomi Mix Fold 5. References to the phone and its chipset were reportedly found in leaked Mi code. The new model could succeed the Xiaomi Mix Fold 4. It could run on the Xring O3 chipset. Mi code reportedly refers to a new handset with model number 2608BPX34C and the internal label Q18.
title: Xiaomi Mix Fold 5 Reportedly in Development With In-House Xring O3 Chip

description: The Redmi A7 4G series is now on sale in India, including the Redmi A7 4G and Redmi A7 Pro 4G. Both offer 120Hz HD+ displays, Unisoc T7250 chipset, and 64GB storage with expansion. The Pro model brings more RAM, higher brightness, a 6,300mAh battery, and Android 16, while the standard version gets a 5,200mAh battery and Android 15. Both phones feature 13-megapixel rear cameras, reverse charging, and IP52-rated designs.
title: Redmi A7 4G, Redmi A7 Pro 4G With Unisoc T7250 Chip, 13-Megapixel Rear Camera Go on Sale in India

description: A viral secret disrupts a businessman’s life as he fights to reclaim respect in his village.
title: Mension House Mallesh Now Available for Streaming Online: Where to Watch This Telugu Romantic Comedy Drama Online?

description: Microsoft has taken several steps to regain favour with its Xbox community since the appointment of Microsoft Gaming CEO Asha Sharma. The company slashed prices for Xbox Game Pass Ultimate and PC tiers. It has also recently reinstated the Xbox branding, which replaces the broader Microsoft Gaming identity, as part of its renewed strategy. Now, a fresh leak suggests that Xbox Game Pass could soon get another major change in the form of a new ‘Starter Edition’ subscription tier.
title: Xbox Game Pass ‘Starter Edition’ Tier Leak Hints at Limited Access, Discord Nitro

description: A teardown of the Oppo Find X9 Ultra reveals its internal design, highlighting large camera modules and advanced cooling. The phone uses a multi-layer motherboard with a central cutout to accommodate its imaging system. It features a vapour chamber, graphite layers, and phase-change material for thermal management. The device packs a 7,050mAh battery with wired and wireless charging, along with symmetrical speakers, multiple sensors, and extensive sealing for durability.
title: Oppo Find X9 Ultra Teardown Video Reveals Internal Design Including Camera Layout, Cooling Design

description: iPhone 18 Pro Max design has been spotted in the images of its dummy unit. The images have been shared by the tech YouTube creator Vadim Yuryev. The images show the dummy units of the iPhone 18 Pro Max and last year’s iPhone 17 Pro Max, comparing the designs of the two smartphones. The rumored iPhone 18 Pro Max appears with a familiar design. However, the Cupertino-based tech giant might make subtle changes to the handset’s camera module, which appears to be bigger than the current generation flagship iPhone model. Similarly, the camera lenses, placed inside the rectangular camera plateau, appear to be bigger on the iPhone 18 Pro Max.
title: iPhone 18 Pro Max Could Sport Familiar Design With Subtle Changes to Camera Module, Leaked Dummy Shows

description: Realme 16T and Realme Watch S5 reportedly received SIRIM certification. The Realme 16T appears to be associated with model number RMX5268, and the Realme Watch S5 bears model number RMW2502. The certification hints that they will be launched soon in global markets. The Realme 16T is expected to arrive as a successor to last year's Realme 15T.  It could launch in three colour options alongside up to 8GB RAM and up to 256GB storage.
title: Realme 16T, Realme Watch S5 Bag SIRIM Certification; Global Launch Seems Imminent

description: Ubisoft finally revealed Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced on Thursday after a string of leaks. The developer showed off all the enhancements coming to the remake in a gameplay overview. Black Flag Resynced will feature improved visuals, reworked combat and parkour, and new story content. The game will launch on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series S/X on July 9.
title: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced Revealed With Gameplay Trailer, Launch Set for July 9

description: OpenAI, on Thursday, introduced a new major update to its GPT-5 series artificial intelligence (AI) models. Bringing it to GPT-5.5, the new models are said to offer improved intent understanding, agentic coding, and reasoning capabilities. The San Francisco-based AI giant claims that the models outperform Anthropic’s latest Claude Opus 4.7 and Google’s Gemini 3.1 Pro models across a wide range of tasks.
title: OpenAI Introduces GPT-5.5 Series AI Models With Improved Agentic Coding and Knowledge Work

description: This is a Gardening Show is a light-hearted educational series where the host engage into conviersations with the local farmers to explore the importance of organic and home farming.
title: This is a Gardening Show Out on OTT: Know Where to Stream This Educational Show Online

description: For years now, Samsung has partnered with Qualcomm to power its flagship smartphones. This has been part of a dual-chip strategy, where select markets have been reserved for models powered by Samsung’s proprietary Exynos, while Snapdragon-powered Galaxy S models have made their way to others. The US-based chipmaker has now hinted that its next-generation Snapdragon chips could also power Samsung’s future flagship smartphones, including the rumoured Samsung Galaxy S27 series, continuing their long-standing partnership.
title: Qualcomm Seemingly Confirms Samsung Galaxy S27 Series Will Feature Next-Generation Snapdragon Chips

description: Honor 600e has been spotted on the Geekbench benchmarking platform with the model number LNA-NX3, according to report. The smartphone is expected to be launched as the fourth smartphone in the tech firm’s Honor 600 series, which currently includes the Honor 600, Honor 600 Pro, and Honor 600 Lite. The handset was reportedly listed on the benchmarking platform with an octa core MediaTek Dimensity 7100 chipset, delivering a peak clock speed of 2.4GHz. It was listed with 8GB of RAM and Android 16.
title: Honor 600e Turns Up on Geekbench With Dimensity 7100 Chip and 8GB RAM: Expected Specifications, Features

description: Bitcoin traded near $78,000 on Friday as institutional inflows supported prices, though profit booking capped gains. Analysts say the market remains range-bound, with resistance near $80,000 and macro cues likely to drive the next move.
title: Ethereum Slips Below $2,300 as Bitcoin Price Steadies Amid Profit Booking

description: The OTT platforms have hit the digital screens with a fresh set of releases, including 24, Band Melam, If Wishes Could Kill, and more.
title: OTT Releases This Week (April 20- April 26): 24, Band Melam, Nukkad Naatak, Prathichaya, If Wishes Could Kill, Greenland 2: Migration, and More

description: Honor has launched the Honor MagicPad 3 Pro 12.3 in China with a 12.3-inch 3K OLED display, 165Hz refresh rate, and up to 3000 nits brightness. Powered by the Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chipset, it offers up to 16GB RAM and 512GB storage, running MagicOS 10 on Android 16. The tablet packs a 10,100mAh battery with 66W fast charging, features an eight-speaker system, advanced VC cooling, and supports keyboard and stylus accessories.
title: Honor MagicPad 3 Pro 12.3 Launched With Snapdragon 8 Gen 5, Slim 4.8mm Profile and 10,100mAh Battery

description: Vivo Y6 5G launched in China with a 7,200mAh battery and support for 44W wired charging. It carries up to 12GB RAM and 256GB of onboard storage. The new Vivo Y series phone runs on a Snapdragon 4 Gen 2 SoC and has a 50-megapixel rear camera unit. It has IP68 and IP69 certifications for dust and water resistance.
title: Vivo Y6 5G Launched With 7,200mAh Battery, Snapdragon 4 Gen 2 Chip: Price, Specifications

description: Vivo Imagine Labs event is being held in New Delhi on Friday (today), the tech firm has announced. The event will give content creators and other Vivo partners the opportunity to test the camera capabilities of the upcoming flagship Vivo X300 Ultra. The smartphone maker has also revealed new details about the Vivo X300 Ultra’s telephoto extender kit. The phone will support the Zeiss-branded Telephoto Extender Gen 2 Ultra kit with a 400mm equivalent focal length, providing 4.7x magnification. The handset is scheduled to be launched in India on May 6 at 12 pm IST, along with the Vivo X300 FE.
title: Vivo X300 Ultra Content Creation Features Showcased at Vivo Imagine Labs Ahead of Launch in India

description: The iQOO 16 was recently reported to have been registered in China and could debut as the company’s next-generation flagship smartphone. Fresh leaks now suggest that another iQOO smartphone is in development, and it is likely to be another flagship or mid-flagship model. According to a tipster, the handset could be powered by the Dimensity 7500 processor. It is also tipped to sport a 2K resolution AMOLED screen and up to an IP69 dust and water resistance rating.
title: iQOO Smartphone With Dimensity 7500 Chip and 8,000mAh Battery in Development, Tipster Claims

description: Xiaomi launched the Redmi Note 15 series earlier this year. The lineup, which previously comprised the standard model, a Pro variant, and the Note 15 Pro+, was recently expanded with the introduction of the Redmi Note 15 SE 5G in India. Rumours about the lineup’s purported successor have now begun surfacing. Fresh leaks suggest that the development of the next-generation model, particularly the Redmi Note 17 Pro Max, is already underway.
title: Redmi Note 17 Pro Max Battery, Camera and Chipset Details Leak; to Feature Dimensity 7500 SoC
